known_caveats: Verifier-reviewed or expert positive county aggregates support historical recorded presence only. Individual occurrence identities and dates are absent from the retained aggregate. Missing rows do not support absence or non-detection, and the legacy bounded merge cannot be subtracted safely without a full source-family rebuild.
source_warnings: The committed EDDMapS snapshot is an undated positive county aggregate; individual occurrence dates and identities are unavailable.
